resources.title: Palworld Feybreak - How To Beat Xenolord, Blazamut Ryu, and Bellanoir Libero - Raid Boss Guide
resources.creator: AncientRune
resources.noteEs: Guía consolidada de los tres raid bosses introducidos en Feybreak. Cubre summon requirements, builds recomendados, weapon picks y estrategia post-meteor para Xenolord. Si vas a hacer raids serias, empezar acá.
resources.noteEn: Consolidated guide to the three raid bosses introduced in Feybreak. Covers summon requirements, recommended builds, weapon picks, and post-meteor strategy for Xenolord. If you'll do serious raids, start here.

resources.title: Palworld - The ULTIMATE Level 60 Oil Rig Guide: Pals, Gear, Chest Locations & More!
resources.creator: Vilestride
resources.noteEs: Versión más actual del guide del Oil Rig: 8 minutos comprimidos con todo lo esencial. Pals, gear, ubicación de chests y patrones de spawn de enemies. Ideal para sesión rápida pre-run.
resources.noteEn: Most current Oil Rig guide: 8 compressed minutes with everything essential. Pals, gear, chest locations, and enemy spawn patterns. Ideal for a quick session pre-run.

resources.title: I Raid The Endgame OIL RIG in Palworld Feybreak
resources.creator: Blitz
resources.noteEs: Walkthrough completo en formato gameplay: 45 minutos de run real con comentario en tiempo real. Útil para ver cómo se siente el Oil Rig sin spoiler vs guías editadas en 8 min.
resources.noteEn: Complete walkthrough in gameplay format: 45 minutes of a real run with live commentary. Useful for seeing how the Oil Rig actually feels, unlike heavily edited 8-minute guides.

resources.title: Palworld - The Only Oil Rig Guide You Need to Watch
resources.creator: TropsPlays

resources.noteEn: Reference guide for the original (Sakurajima) Oil Rig. Entry routes and core mechanic still apply; the only thing that's changed is the recommended Pals with newer buffs.

resources.title: Como CAPTURAR A LOS JEFES DE TORRE en PALWORLD y otros consejos - DSimphony
resources.creator: DSimphony
resources.noteEs: Una de las pocas guías serias en español sobre cómo enfrentar Tower Bosses, incluyendo el trick de capturarlos (que sí, se puede). 21 minutos densos con explicación clara.
